request.style: English, male country voice, solo, acoustic guitar, steel guitar, fiddle, upright bass, mournful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Zillah gave birth to a new son
Cain was building his first city
Lamech took two wives for his own
One named Adah, the other Zillah

[Verse]
Adah bore Jabal the nomad
Father of those with tents and flocks
Jubal played the lyre and pipe
Father of all who hear the song

[Chorus]
Tubal-Cain forged the metal tools
Out of bronze and iron bright
He shaped the hammer and the tongs
Under the heavy weight of night

[Verse]
His sister Naamah stood beside
Name recorded in the old genealogy
Jabal lived among the tents
Jubal played the ancient melodies

[Chorus]
Tubal-Cain forged the metal tools
Out of bronze and iron bright
He shaped the hammer and the tongs
Under the heavy weight of night

[Bridge]
Lamech sang to Adah and Zillah
Hear my voice and listen close
I killed a man for wounding me
A young man for his slight abuse

[Outro]
If Cain is avenged seven times
Lamech seventy-seven times
Forged from bronze and iron
In the lineage of Cain
